chapter_summary: Gu Suizhou, frustrated by a rival stock market trader, tasks Leapton with uncovering their identity. Panicked by an impending visit from Shen Feizhi, Gu Suizhou manipulates Leapton into calling Lin Sui to distract Shen Feizhi. Leapton, in turn, realizes Lin Sui is his crush. Shen Feizhi arrives at the High School and confronts Lin Sui, subtly hinting at his knowledge of Lin Sui's dark obsession and activities in the 'Underground City.' Shen Feizhi then exchanges contact information with Lin Sui, likely for surveillance. Finally, Shen Feizhi confronts Gu Suizhou, who has faked a leg injury to avoid him. Aware of the deception, Shen Feizhi physically punishes Gu Suizhou, underscoring their complex and antagonistic brotherly relationship.

relationship_changes.description: Leapton realizes that Lin Sui, the person Gu Suizhou asked him to call, is the same person he has a crush on.
Lin Sui's obsession with Shen Feizhi is revealed to be extremely dark, as he keeps several individuals resembling Shen Feizhi captive in a basement.
It is explicitly confirmed that Gu Suizhou and Shen Feizhi are brothers, and their relationship is characterized by a 'bitter rift.'
Shen Feizhi physically punishes Gu Suizhou for faking an injury, highlighting his harsh methods of teaching Gu Suizhou a lesson and their complex, antagonistic relationship.
